## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue when applicable.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Explain any checks that were not applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR targets `development` from a feature branch.
- [ ] Changes fit the documented scope; architectural decisions or new dependencies are justified.
- [ ] Relevant build, tests and packaging checks pass.
- [ ] Behavior changes have meaningful tests and updated documentation.
- [ ] Schemas and public contracts preserve compatibility or document the change.
- [ ] No credentials, raw reports, private bundles or local planning/learning files are included.
